name: hgi_sm_xl2p_bdring_1018-p1-COMMIT
purpose: x-load BD ring leaf with the PRE bypass words (x_fmt 3); successor of hgi_sm_xl2_bdring

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2p_bdring u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2p.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xl2p_bdring_1018/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xl2p_bdring_1018/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xl2p_bdring_1018 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_sm_xload_cl2p_bdring  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: cl2p bdring = main's closed cl2 bdring (86.4 x 302.4, cl2f faces) + bypass word pins pq_lo/hi (256), pe_lo/hi (10), pvo_lo/hi on the S face (534 pins 6.2/um; N face stays the 532 quantiser pins), pin-registered on the same edge as qq/qe and selected after the pins (ps ? wp : wr) -- one 2:1 mux in front of the ring write, no new path from a pin
